Messages.Author: Marko Saari
Messages.Body:
Hi

I have two questions:

1. Can Caitiff become a prince by calling praxis seizure?

2. Can two (or more) different vampires reduce same bleed with Telepathic
Counter?
For example Leandro is bleeding me 4. Dorian Strack plays Telepathic
Counter to reduce bleed to 2. Can I play Telepathic Counter with
Felicia reducing bleed to zero?

Thanks in advance.

Marko

Messages.Author: Richard D. Zopf
Messages.Body:
"Marko Saari" <gu...@sci.fi> wrote:
>Hi

>I have two questions:

>1. Can Caitiff become a prince by calling praxis seizure?

Yes.

>2. Can two (or more) different vampires reduce same bleed with Telepathic
>Counter?
> For example Leandro is bleeding me 4. Dorian Strack plays Telepathic
>Counter to reduce bleed to 2. Can I play Telepathic Counter with
>Felicia reducing bleed to zero?

Your example is correct. Limitations on the number of reaction cards
played are always "per minion". Thus, the same multiplicity counts
for multiple vamps playing, say intercept... (example: Brasil plays
Enhanced Senses at inferior, stealth gets upped to +2, and Lucian
plays ES at Superior)
Regards,
R. David Zopf

and future Prince of Charlotte, NC
